body:
Delivered the complete independent current-increment B01 result-and-plan scientific review for the fixed task at 859b18b05bca3985ce7a34662e500a85a563e7aa.

[Read the complete review at delivery commit a006871c828a211c7873b06a156cad6ca1d42227](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/a006871c828a211c7873b06a156cad6ca1d42227/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260914_current_increment_b01_result_plan_review/archive/RESPONSE.md).

All 155 lines, including reference definitions, were read back at that commit. Comparison with its actual parent 2f5457cd77697d6edd87ef74d8482a31e3739b99 confirms one commit adding only the authorized RESPONSE.md on codex/vap-folr; concurrent branch changes are preserved.

The review identifies no result-invalidating defect in the documented Z–G comparison and retains GENERIC_ABOVE_MEI at its fitted-program scope. It favors preparing two prospectively fixed fresh A–G blocks while treating one as a scientifically adequate, substantially cheaper alternative. The marginal-value argument, outcome-informed selection, per-block reporting, calibration, uncertainty and heterogeneous cost limits are explicit. Historical A–G/A–Z/replacement-BANK evidence and all technical limitations retain their original scope.

This is the posed independent scientific review, not a new invocation, grant, Portfolio action, family/lifecycle decision or C freeze. No scientific code, test, checkpoint load, raw-result reanalysis or experiment was executed. No other repository file, prior response or branch was modified by this delivery. The DM retains full-response intake and substantive response to findings.
